pickup.title: Pickup
pickup.intro: Open a lobby, pick the teams yourselves, and play. Extra players wait their turn in the waiting room.
pickup.error: That did not work. Try again.
pickup.noneHint: Open one and the others can join it.
pickup.closedHint: Open a new one from the Pickup page.
pickup.teamsLocked: Teams are locked. Only the host can move players.
pickup.teamsOpen: Players can choose and switch sides.

settings.title: Match settings
settings.rollOut: After a match, who rolls out

methodHint.veto: After the ready check the two teams ban maps in turn on the match page.
methodHint.vote: After the ready check the seated players vote for the map.

controls.startHint: Both teams must be full to start.

captains.host: First player of each team as captain

log.title: Lobby log
log.ready_timed_out: The ready check ran out. Players moved to the waiting room: {{late}}.
log.match_starting: Everyone is ready. Match {{number}} is starting.

match_won.a: Match {{number}} is over. Team A won.
match_won.b: Match {{number}} is over. Team B won.

log.rolled_out: {{player}} rolled out to the waiting room.
log.rule_losers: {{actor}} set roll-out to the losing team.
log.rule_most_played: {{actor}} set roll-out to whoever has played longest.
log.closed_idle: The lobby closed after two hours with nothing happening.
log.draft_finished: The draft is done. Teams are locked.

method.pick: {{actor}} set the map to the host's pick.
method.veto: {{actor}} set the map to a veto between the teams.
method.vote: {{actor}} set the map to a vote.

log.map_vote: Everyone is ready. Vote for the map.
log.map_voted_none: Nobody voted: the map is drawn.
log.substitution_failed: The match server did not take {{player}} for {{other}}.
log.substitution_retried: {{actor}} sent the substitution of {{player}} for {{other}} again.
log.substitution_undone: {{actor}} undid the substitution: {{other}} plays on, {{player}} waits.

refusal.not_allowed: Only the host or an admin can do that.
refusal.not_in_lobby: That player is not in the lobby.
refusal.team_size_below_seated: A team has more players than that team size.
refusal.not_enough_players: Seat at least two players first.
refusal.in_other_lobby: You are already in another lobby.
refusal.wrong_state: That cannot be done right now.
refusal.in_match: Not while the match is running.
refusal.teams_not_full: Both teams must be full first.
refusal.invalid_map: That map is not in the pool.
refusal.invalid_captains: Choose two different players in the lobby as captains.
refusal.invite_only: This lobby is for invited players only.
refusal.unknown_player: That player has never signed in to the site.
refusal.invite_link_invalid: That invite link no longer works. Ask the host for a new one.
refusal.not_on_roster: That player is not playing in the match.
refusal.not_eligible: Only someone in the waiting room can come in.
refusal.already_subbed_out: That player already left this match and cannot come back into it.
refusal.may_not_spectate: Only someone in the lobby who is not playing can spectate.
refusal.spectate_refused: The match server did not take that. Try again in a moment.
refusal.unknown: That did not work. Try again.
